agent_assumptions: Plan coordinate convention retained from seed: x=0 West, x=15 East, y=0 South, y=8 North, reflect-corrected and confirmed by North/South elevation window+door spacing matches.
Uniform wall abstraction; centerline grid at x=0/5/7.5/10/11.25/15, y=0/3/5/8.
Floor heights F1=3.0m, F2=3.6m (absolute F2 z_floor=3.0), per elevations.
F1 South row door D_F1_S1_ext at x=0.54-1.44m verified directly against South_view.png cyan door outline pixels (orig px 344-395, mm 560-1451) - matches seed, unchanged.
F1_S1 secondary window corrected to x=3.44-4.64m, z=1.5-2.1m based on direct pixel measurement of South_view.png cyan window box and the 900/600/1500 vertical sub-chain.

F2 office row doors corrected: each of O1-O4 has exactly one door to the corridor, positioned immediately adjacent to its shared partition (O1@2.19-3.39, O2@4.11-5.31, O3@9.69-10.89, O4@11.61-12.81), matching the paired-arc image evidence and coinciding x-spans with the south-facade windows above. The seed's extra doors at O1 (0.8-1.6) and O4 (13.4-14.2) were unsupported duplicates and removed.
No door confirmed between F2 O2 and O3 (plain wall, no arcs) - retained from seed.
F1 corridor doors (N1/N2/N3 and mirrored S1/S2/S3) verified directly: paired arcs at N1/N2 and S1/S2 partitions, single arcs flanking N2/N3 and S2/S3 partitions - matches seed geometry, unchanged.

F2 M1/M2 paired doors at the central partition verified visually (arcs present); exact span kept from seed pending finer dimension-chain reconciliation (minor <1m uncertainty, not a duplication/identity issue).
No staircase is drawn on either plan; F1-F2 vertical connectivity remains unmodeled.
Door swing state remains unknown for all doors (not indicated in drawings).
unresolved: No staircase/vertical circulation drawn; F1-F2 connectivity not modeled.
Wall thicknesses vary (240/340/360mm); represented by a single centerline grid, not literal face offsets.
Door swing/open state not indicated on drawings; all doors state=unknown.

F2 M1/M2 door span kept from seed's estimate (6.6-7.5 / 7.5-8.4m); direct pixel measurement of the central jamb lines suggested a slightly different span (~7.05-7.81m envelope) but the exact leaf width was not independently re-dimensioned; treated as a minor offset, not a duplication/identity error.
Exact corridor clear width has a <0.3m discrepancy between two plan dimension chains; 2.0m adopted.

F1 exterior West door (D_F1_W_ext) and East/West corridor windows retained from seed as originally sourced; not re-verified pixel-by-pixel in this audit pass (verified only doors/windows explicitly targeted by the one-to-one opening audit: F1 south row, F1_S1 window, and all F2 office-row doors).
